title: Compliance milestone heatmap and dependency matrix for SOC2/ISO rollouts
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Purpose: create a single canonical milestone heatmap and dependency matrix that consolidates SOC2 and ISO27001 readiness work (SSO/SAML, audit logging, evidence retention, KMS integration). The deliverable will be a living artifact used by PM, Eng, Security and Sales to track gating criteria, owners, blockers, and mitigation paths across cycles. This ticket coordinates cross-functional owners, surfaces high-risk dependencies, and defines acceptance criteria for gating each compliance milestone.
milestones: M1: Audit logging baseline - enable tenant-level audit streaming (owner: ENG-Observability) - target: 2025-02-20
M2: SSO/SAML integration maturity - complete IdP metadata automation + e2e QA (owner: ENG-Security) - target: 2025-03-01
M3: Evidence pipeline - automated evidence exports for SOC2 controls (owner: PM/Evidence) - target: 2025-03-10
M4: KMS/HSM sign-off - production key lifecycle + rotation policy (owner: Security Ops) - target: 2025-03-15
M5: ISO documentation package - finalize scope, responsibilities, and control mappings (owner: PM-Compliance) - target: 2025-03-12
acceptance_criteria: Each milestone has a named owner and a documented set of gate criteria in Confluence
Automated test or runbook exists for evidence extraction for at least 3 representative customer tenants
Audit logs are exportable to a long-term storage location with retention policy documented
SSO/SAML flows pass end-to-end tests with IdP metadata rotation and failure fallback documented
KMS integration tested in staging with documented key rotation and emergency key-revocation playbook
rollout_plan: Phase A (internal): validate features in dedicated staging tenants; use canary subset of internal customers for smoke tests
Phase B (beta customers): enable features for selected customers with explicit acceptance clauses and runbook handoff
Phase C (general availability): flip default, publish runbooks and update onboarding templates; include config checklist in Console
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Audit log volume spikes could increase storage/costs - Mitigation: implement sampling + TTL policy and provide cost estimate to Sales
Risk: IdP metadata churn from enterprise customers - Mitigation: add automated metadata refresh and health-check alerts
Risk: Evidence pipeline gaps across older model versions - Mitigation: define minimal supported runtime and backlog for retrofitting evidence adapters
